AIM Workshop “Pólya-Schur-Lax Problems: Hyperbolicity and Stability
Preservers” — A List of Open Problems
record.context_brief: Zeros of deformed Riemann Xi and strip-preserving heat flow
record.original_question: For the deformations Ξ_λ of the Riemann Ξ-function, is it true that for every λ<0 almost all zeros of Ξ_λ are real, and more generally, if f is an even real entire function of order 1 and maximal type with zeros in a horizontal strip, do all but finitely many zeros of e^{-λD^2}f become real and simple for every λ>0?

evidence.quote: Problem 5 (H. Ki, Y.-O. Kim). Let Ξ(z) be the Riemann Ξ-function: Z ∞ Ξ(z) = Φ(t)eizt dt, −∞ where Φ(t) = 2 ∞ X 2 2t (2n4 π 2 e9t/2 − 3n2 πe5t/2 )e−n πe . n=1 Define Ξλ (z) by Z ∞ Ξλ (z) = 2 Φ(t)eλt eizt dt.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let Φ : ℝ → ℝ be the function

   Φ(t) = Σ_{n≥1} (2n⁴π² e^{9t/2} − 3n²π e^{5t/2}) exp(−n²π e^{2t}),

and define the Riemann Ξ-function by

   Ξ(z) = ∫_{−∞}^{∞} Φ(t) e^{i z t} dt.

For each real parameter λ define the deformation

   Ξ_λ(z) = ∫_{−∞}^{∞} Φ(t) e^{λ t²} e^{i z t} dt.

(Equivalently, with D = d/dz, one has Ξ_λ = e^{−λ D²} Ξ.) 

(a) Show that for every λ < 0, all but finitely many zeros of Ξ_λ are real.

(b) More generally, let f be an even real entire function of order 1 and maximal type whose zeros all lie in some horizontal strip {z ∈ ℂ : |Im z| ≤ A}. Show that for every λ > 0, all but finitely many zeros of (e^{−λ D²} f)(z) are real and simple.
artifact.category_tag: Zeros of entire functions and heat flow
artifact.status_search_result: Related developments exist: Ki–Kim–Lee proved an upper bound Λ < 1/2 on the de Bruijn–Newman constant, and Rodgers–Tao established Λ ≥ 0, with subsequent effective numerical bounds Λ ≤ 0.22. These results concern the heat-flow evolution H_t of Ξ but do not directly establish the "all but finitely many zeros real" statement for λ < 0 in the stated deformation, nor the general strip-to-real claim under the backward heat operator. No source verifying or refuting the precise conjectures above was found.

status_evidence.title: Effective approximation of heat flow evolution of the Riemann ξ function
status_evidence.snippet: Effective estimates on H_t and a new upper bound for the de Bruijn–Newman constant.
status_evidence.claim: Heat-flow evolution of Ξ is well-studied; effective bounds on Λ exist but do not directly resolve the stated deformation problem.

status_evidence.title: On the de Bruijn–Newman constant
status_evidence.snippet: Ki, Kim and Lee established Λ < 1/2.
status_evidence.claim: Ki–Kim–Lee proved a strict upper bound on Λ, related to but distinct from the conjecture stated.

status_evidence.title: Orthogonal polynomial expansions for the Riemann xi function
status_evidence.snippet: Romik's work on Ξ and its expansions.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work on Ξ does not settle the strip-to-real conjecture for general even entire functions of order 1 maximal type.
